title: Symbolic machine learning for vapor-liquid equilibrium prediction in nitrogen + n-alkane mixtures
summary: The first result-bearing arXiv version reports symbolic regression corrections to the Peng–Robinson equation using experimental vapor–liquid-equilibrium data from six nitrogen/n-alkane mixtures. Its held-out comparisons show substantially lower pressure-prediction error than the uncorrected equation. This is a specific thermodynamics result, limited to the reported mixtures and pointwise split.
ai_technology: Official arXiv v1 full text, Methods and Results; first posted 2026-08-06. DOI journal version has matching study title/authors and describes the same nitrogen+n-alkane VLE task; no evidence of a separate earlier result version. The reported random pointwise 80/20 split limits generalization claims.
